name: Grommash Ironhide
title: Hoardkeeper
description: A battle-scarred orc with iron-gray skin and tusks decorated with war trophies. Grommash guards the clan's communal war spoils with fierce loyalty and unexpected wisdom.

greeting.first_time: You stand before Grommash, Keeper of the Warhoard. Speak your business, outsider, and know that I do not suffer thieves.
greeting.returning: Your tribute was accepted. Your cache remains untouched.
greeting.native_race: Strength to you, warrior. The clan hoard welcomes you.

about_service.text: The Warhoard holds the spoils of every battle our clan has won. Every orc of Marshlight may claim their share of storage—it is our right by blood and steel. But outsiders must prove themselves worthy. You will pay the Tribute of Iron, or you will store nothing here.

ask_about_tribute.text: Tribute. Not coin — coin is what weak clans give. Bring steel. A battleaxe, whole and keen, for the war hoard. Buy it, loot it, take it off something that wanted it more — Grommash does not ask which.

pay_tribute.text: Hah! Good weight. It hangs with the others. You are in the hoard now, and here is what the hoard is: not a hole in my swamp. Every keeper's hoard is the one hoard, warded and shared. Leave your spoils with me, collect them in the golden city if that is where your feet go. Keys, not holes.
pay_tribute.success: Grommash accepted your tribute at the War Hoard. You may store items here.
pay_tribute.failure: No steel, no tribute. Bring Grommash a battleaxe.

use_storage.text: Follow. Do not touch what is not yours. And know this of the hoard: it is not a pit in my swamp. It is the one hoard, warded, and every keeper holds a key — even the gold-counting lizard in his harbor. Leave your spoils. They will find you wherever you walk.

maybe_later.text: Then go. The Warhoard does not wait for the weak of will.

goodbye.text: Strength and steel. May your enemies fall swiftly.

claim_birthright.text: You are of the clan. Then you have already paid, in blood that was not yours to give twice. No tribute. Your share of the hoard has waited for you.
claim_birthright.success: Grommash granted your share of the War Hoard by right of blood.
claim_birthright.failure: There seems to be some irregularity. Speak with me again.

homeward_stone.text: Homeward Stone. A trophy from the clan hoard, bonded to the waystone in this mud-town. Every orc of Marshlight carries one, and it drags you home once a week. Outsiders get one when they've proven themselves to the clan. Prove it.

options.label: [Orc] The hoard never gave me my stone.

homeward_gift.text: Then take it. From the hoard, to the clan's own. Lose it and you pay for the next, like anyone.

homeward_shop.text: Marshlight stones, bonded to our waystone. You want one, you pay. One each.
